description:
Use this when the user asks about daily FII flow by sector in the historical CDSL data, which stops at March 2025. For current sector flows use get_sector_fpi_investment.

Returns daily FII/FPI buy, sell and net value by sector from CDSL's disclosures. The data covers CDSL only and ends in March 2025. `from_date` and `to_date` are ISO dates at most 366 days apart; when they are omitted the window is the 30 days up to the latest data held, and `effective_from` and `effective_to` give the dates covered. `sector` filters to one sector; a name that is not found returns the valid names. For current flow by sector use get_sector_fpi_investment.
name: get_sector_fii_flow
title: FII flow by sector (historical)
